product_summary: TVH India Private Ltd (Regd Office: 15th Floor, Tower 3, Fountainhead, Phoenix Market City, Nagar Road, Vimannagar, Pune 411014; tel +91 20 67 61 74 00) is the Indian branch of Belgian TVH Parts Holding NV, self-described as 'Your leading parts specialist for off-road machinery' and 'Parts specialist since 1969'. Per https://www.tvh.com/en-in/parts the company supplies PARTS (not machines) for: material handling, industrial equipment, agricultural equipment and small earth-moving equipment. The published equipment taxonomy (https://www.tvh.com/en-in/parts/parts-for) is: Forklifts; Warehouse equipment; Mobile elevating work platforms (MEWP); Telehandlers; Small earth-moving equipment; Ground support equipment; Industrial floor sweepers; Industrial floor scrubbers; Truck-mounted forklifts; Sideloaders; Liftgates; Golf carts; Container handling equipment; Tractors; Harvesting equipment; Tillage equipment; Hay equipment. The site also states a database of 49,500,000 part numbers, an online webshop, a 'Service & Repair' offer, an 'Electronics department', remanufactured parts, and 'Our brands & partnerships'. So the real product lines are: forklift/wheel-loader/telehandler/MEWP spare parts (mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, body/chassis, filters, tyres, attachments), remanufactured components, and repair services. No mining, metallurgical, smelting, ore-processing or foundry equipment appears anywhere in the published catalogue.
comment: HS-6 mapping of the real catalogue: (1) Parts identifiable as parts of lifting/handling machinery of headings 8425-8428 (forklift masts, forks, carriages, counterweights, telehandler/MEWP booms, container-handling spreader parts) -> 8431.20 and 8431.49; parts of bulldozers/angledozers -> 8431.31; of graders/levellers -> 8431.42; of scrapers/mechanical shovels/excavators -> 8431.41/8431.43; of agricultural/horticultural machinery -> 8432.90 and 8436.99; parts of harvesting/threshing machinery -> 8433.90; parts of lifting/handling machinery n.e.s. -> 8431.39. VERDICT ON DECLARED CODES: 843139 (parts of other lifting/handling machinery) and 848390 (parts of transmission elements) are both CORRECT and genuinely present in the catalogue - they are the two most plausible core lines for a forklift/telehandler parts distributor. Status = partial, not exact, because the declaration covers only 2 of the ~15-20 HS-6 families that the published catalogue actually spans: it omits 8431.20 (forklift parts, the single largest line), 8431.49, 8431.31/8431.41/8431.42/8431.43 (earth-moving parts), 8432.90/8433.90/8436.99 (agricultural parts), 8482.xx (bearings), 8483.10-8483.60 (shafts/gears/clutches), 8412/8413/8481 (hydraulics), 8501/8536/8544/8539/8512/8511 (electrical), 8421.23/8421.31 (filters), 4011/4016 (tyres and rubber), 7318/7320 (fasteners), 8484 (gaskets), 9401.20 (seats), 8708.xx (tractor/truck parts), 8208/8207 (blades and tools). INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: the declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy and mining) is WRONG. TVH India is a spare-parts distributor for material handling, warehouse, construction/earth-moving and agricultural equipment; there is no metallurgical, smelting, ore-dressing or mining-equipment line in the published catalogue. The correct industry is wholesale/distribution of machinery parts (material handling & off-road equipment aftermarket). TRADER SIGNS: strong. The company does not manufacture - it is the Indian sales/service arm of a Belgian parts holding (TVH Parts Holding NV, per the site footer '© 2003-2026 TVH Parts Holding NV'), sells third-party and own-brand parts through a webshop, and offers remanufactured parts and repair services. Role = trader (possibly manufacturer_trader only if remanufacturing is treated as production; the site does not evidence own manufacturing). Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch and the industry misclassification are NOT grounds for rejection - the company stays in the base, the codes are corrected to the actual lines above, and the verdict is accepted_hs_corrected. EVIDENCE LIMITS: all product statements above come from the company's own website (tvh.com/en-in), i.e. they are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, bill of lading or GST record was examined in this HS-only review, so no shipment-level corroboration of any specific HS code exists here. Revenue, export volume, CIN, PAN and registration data were deliberately not researched (out of scope for this role) and are null.
